SIGNALS.name: Tencent 腾讯
SIGNALS.summary: Tencent says Hy4 flash is live on its TokenHub, WorkBuddy and Yuanbao. It is natively multimodal, has a 1M-token context window and decodes at over 150 tokens per second.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA AI Infrastructure
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA introduced Rubin HPC, a GPU in the Vera Rubin platform aimed at simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics work.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to develop a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model, the first post on its new science blog.

SIGNALS.name: Rohan Paul
SIGNALS.summary: Citing the FT, Rohan Paul says Nvidia's D&O insurance covers leaders' personal assets up to $900M but not company legal costs, amid a proposed investor class action against Nvidia and Huang.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: AGTP reports Anthropic added an experimental Code Mode to Claude Code v2.1.323, where Claude writes code to chain tool calls instead of requesting Bash, Read or Edit one at a time.

SIGNALS.name: Amir Husain
SIGNALS.summary: Amir Husain says DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B) runs locally at 18.7 tokens/s on a roughly $2,600 desktop built from a 12 GB RTX 3060, a Quadro M4000 and 544 GB of DDR4.

SIGNALS.name: Developing Adventures
SIGNALS.summary: A developer account says Claude Code 2.1.325 contains four hidden switches, including a weekly limit-reset command and a brief-updates mode. Unconfirmed by Anthropic.
